system.description:
MYRATHI

When your own knowledge fails, older minds reach upward through the roots.
When Ancestral Communion affects a Recall Knowledge check using a non-specialist skill in which you possess no ranks, you may make that check as though you possessed 1 rank in the skill.
Be aware that this does not grant access to specialist skills.

Prerequisites Level 5

Works automatically: Ancestral Communion's Use waives the trained gate for one Recall Knowledge in a non-specialist skill you have no ranks in.
